about: Single-channel isolated relay output module, 18mm wide. A volt-free contact or NPN proximity switch on the 24V input loop drives one 8A changeover contact, with 4kV isolation between supply, input and output. Used to interface a fire panel to HVAC, lifts or door releases.

Two-channel isolated relay output module, 36mm wide. Each channel has its own volt-free input and 8A changeover contact, separated from the mains supply and from each other's circuits. Red LED per channel, green LED for power.

Four-channel isolated relay output module, 72mm wide. Lets one fire-alarm or PLC output drive four dissimilar circuits that must not share a reference. Outputs are 8A resistive at 240VAC or 30VDC; contacts are rated for 100,000 electrical operations.

Eight-channel isolated relay output module, 105mm wide - eight isolated 8A changeover contacts in the space of six modules. Check the isolation table before relying on the full 4kV input-to-output figure on this version.
